entries.zh: 陪巡：陪同巡视（陪同上司巡查、出巡）；亦指陪同拜访
entries.en: to accompany (a superior) on an inspection tour / official visit; to accompany a caller

entries.zh: 陪随：陪伴相随，不离左右
entries.en: to accompany closely, keep company without leaving one's side

entries.zh: 随：跟随、随行
entries.en: to follow, go along with, accompany

entries.zh: 随带：随身带着、随行携带
entries.en: to bring along, take with one (person or thing)

entries.zh: 随从：跟随、随行；亦指随从人员、随员
entries.en: to follow in attendance, accompany; (n.) retinue, attendants

entries.zh: 随跟：跟随伺候，如仆人随侍主人
entries.en: to follow and attend one's master like a servant

entries.zh: 随护：随行护卫、陪护
entries.en: to escort and protect, accompany as a guard

entries.zh: 送：相送、送行；亦指赠送
entries.en: to see off, accompany a departing person; to give, present (a gift)

entries.zh: 辅：辅助、襄助
entries.en: to assist, aid, support

entries.zh: 辅佐：辅佐治理，襄理政务
entries.en: to assist (a ruler) in government, serve as aide in administration

entries.zh: 辅弼：辅弼君王，匡辅政事
entries.en: to assist and counsel the sovereign in ruling; chief support of the throne

entries.zh: 送：送行、送别；亦指递送
entries.en: to send off, see someone off; to deliver

entries.zh: 送亲：送别亲人，送出门至道口；亦指婚俗中送嫁
entries.en: to see (kin) off, accompany them out to the gate; in wedding custom, to escort the bride
entries.notes: H「送親」可读作送别亲人出门（合 L 栏 saliendo hasta la puerta 送至门口），亦可指婚俗送嫁，两解并存

entries.zh: 送葬：随送灵柩下葬，送殡
entries.en: to follow the dead to burial, attend a funeral procession

entries.zh: 行程：陪行一程、同行一段路；亦作名词指路程、行程
entries.en: to go part of the way together, accompany a stretch of the road; (n.) journey, itinerary

entries.zh: 牵引、带着走、引领（字头存疑，拟作「𤆬」）
entries.en: to lead by the hand, take (someone) along
entries.notes: H 栏字形存疑（焦/炰/𤆬），按闽南语 chhuā「牵引带着走」之义拟定为「𤆬」

entries.zh: 𤆬嫁：引领、陪送新娘出嫁（首字存疑）
entries.en: to escort / lead the bride in marriage, accompany the newlyweds
entries.notes: 首字承上条字形存疑，合读「𤆬嫁」＝陪送新娘；L 栏明言陪同新人（los desposados）

entries.zh: 轿后人：随轿跟班，步随轿后伺候，如侍从
entries.en: attendants walking behind a sedan chair, sedan-chair followers (as a squire)

entries.zh: 绊：羁绊相随、绊住作伴；或为「伴」之讹，作陪伴
entries.en: to keep company, stay tethered alongside; character possibly an error for 伴 'to accompany'
entries.notes: 「絆」本义绊脚、羁绊，置于 acompañar 词头下当取「相随作伴」义，或系「伴」之形讹

entries.zh: 徇：依从、屈从（徇从他人之见）；或为「询」之形近，咨询求教
entries.en: to comply with / yield to another's counsel; character possibly for 询 'to inquire, ask advice'
entries.notes: 「徇」本义依从，与 aconsejar 词头相配可疑，或为「询」形近致讹；M 栏另有 (c.art.) 注记未展开

entries.zh: 点醒：点破提醒，使人醒悟
entries.en: to point out, open someone's eyes; to advise, remind

entries.zh: 失点检：失于检点，疏忽失察
entries.en: to fail to examine oneself, neglect due care and order
entries.notes: L 栏词头首音节缺佚，[acon]sejar 为展开推断；「失点检」＝失于检点，与词头义合较弱
